Category Specification / MeitY Model Technical Specification / ATC Restrictions The category has been created in accordance with the Model Technical Specification issued by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) vide letter No. W-43/4/2020-IPHW dated 19.08.2024 and is based on the parameters defined therein. Buyers shall not prescribe, through Buyer Added ATCs, any technical parameter, allowed value, particular processor, processor brand, processor manufacturer or other requirement which restricts or overrides the Category Specifications. Clause 2(e) of the GeM General Terms and Conditions (GTC) shall apply accordingly. 2. Product Verification Each supplied Device shall bear a unique device serial number or other unique device identifier traceable to the OEM. The Buyer/Consignee shall be able to verify the authenticity of the supplied product including the configuration through the OEM website. 3. Requirement of OEM Logo Buyers shall not prescribe a requirement for embossing, engraving, printing or affixing the OEM name/logo on the motherboard or any internal component. 4. Operating System - OEM/Publisher Status There shall be no mandatory requirement that the OEM of the offered device should be a Microsoft Device Partner or hold any specific Microsoft authorisation. Where an Operating System other than Microsoft Windows is offered, no specific partner status or authorisation from the concerned Operating System publisher/provider shall be mandated. 5. Operating System - Licensing Where Microsoft Windows is supplied, it shall be a genuine, legally licensed and duly activated copy of the Windows edition/version declared in the catalogue, and the licence shall be obtained through a licensing or distribution mechanism authorised by Microsoft. Where any other Operating System is supplied, it shall comply with the applicable licensing terms and conditions of the concerned Operating System publisher/provider, wherever licensing is applicable. 6. Operating System - Verification Where Microsoft Windows is supplied pre-installed, the Buyer/Consignee shall be able to verify that the supplied Windows Operating System is genuine and duly activated through the OEM, i.e. Microsoft. A valid digital licence or any other licensing mechanism permitted by Microsoft for the supplied device shall be acceptable. Where any other Operating System is supplied, similar verification of licence authenticity and/or activation status shall be required only where the concerned Operating System publisher/provider provides a device-level or equivalent verification mechanism. Where no such verification mechanism is provided, this requirement shall not apply. 7. Operating System - Applicability The requirements relating specifically to Microsoft Windows licensing, activation and verification shall apply where Microsoft Windows forms part of the contracted configuration. Where an Operating System other than Microsoft Windows is supplied, the applicable licensing requirements of the concerned Operating System publisher/provider shall be complied with, and verification of licence authenticity and/or activation shall be required only where such verification is supported by the concerned Operating System publisher/provider. 8. Operating System-specific Certification / Compatibility Hardware compatibility certificate prescribed by a particular Operating System publisher/provider may be requested by buyers.
